choice_descriptions.CRITICAL: Widespread production outage or active data loss.
choice_descriptions.HIGH: A customer's critical operation is blocked without a workaround.
choice_descriptions.NORMAL: Moderate degradation with work able to continue.
choice_descriptions.LOW: No current business impact or an optional enhancement.

requires_review.description: True if the incident requires immediate human review because customers cannot complete a critical business operation; otherwise false.

choice_descriptions.PAGE_ON_CALL: Immediate response to widespread outage or data loss.
choice_descriptions.EXPEDITE: Urgent targeted response to a major blocked customer.
choice_descriptions.NORMAL_QUEUE: Schedule a fix for a moderate issue with a workaround.
choice_descriptions.BACKLOG: Optional future work with no current business impact.
